name: drhelius/Gearboy
description: A cross-platform Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator with high accuracy (passes Blargg's CPU tests), debugging tools including breakpoints and a just-in-time disassembler, available for Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD, and RetroArch.
score_rationale: Accurate Game Boy emulator with 1.1k stars, valuable for both gameplay and Game Boy homebrew development due to its debugging tools.
summary: Accurate Game Boy emulator with built-in debugging tools
